page.layout: One page of text, one column; margin notes at left and right edges, some faint and partly cut off by the scan edge. Running head at top left and top centre, page number top right. Title block centred, then chapter heading, then body text with a drop cap, notes in the margins.

main_text.l: Anni sunt 190. ab A. C. 611. ad
Es ab HERACLIO gestas tribus periodis egor.
vit, plena perplexitatis erat. Persæ enim
scientes, arma deponere volebant. Hinc factum
in potestatem Cosrhois devenerunt. Saraceni in
missi ab Heraclio legati, fine relpor.so dimit-te-
rentur. Hierosolymâ captâ, ad XCM hominum
a Judæis, vili precio sanguinem Christianorum.

page.notes: The scan is faint and several marginal notes are partly illegible; the Greek-free text contains marked uncertain readings (e.g. "Tercommode", "Arcenius", "relpor.so", "XCM") that are best checked against the original. Some footnote marks are unclear. The printed line "Yy 3" is a gathering signature, not a catchword; the bottom word "com-" is the catchword.
